sql:
SELECT game_id, season, scoring_margin
FROM games
WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots")
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1;

WITH GameBettingAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        AVG(bd.betting_odds) AS avg_betting_odds,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bets
    FROM games g
    JOIN betting_data bd ON g.game_id = bd.game_id
    GROUP BY g.game_id
),
WeatherImpactAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.weather_conditions,
        vec.distance AS weather_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM games
        WHERE weather_conditions_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Sunny weather conditions during the game")
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 3
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
),
PredictionConfidence AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        AVG(gp.confidence_level) AS avg_prediction_confidence
    FROM game_predictions gp
    GROUP BY gp.game_id
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        tm.season,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa
    FROM team_metrics tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_id, tm.season
),
LocationSimilarity AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM games
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots")
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
)
SELECT 
    g.game_id
FROM games g
JOIN GameBettingAnalysis gba ON g.game_id = gba.game_id
JOIN WeatherImpactAnalysis wia ON g.game_id = wia.game_id
JOIN PredictionConfidence pc ON g.game_id = pc.game_id
JOIN TeamPerformance tp ON g.home_team_id = tp.team_id
JOIN LocationSimilarity ls ON g.game_id = ls.game_id
WHERE pc.avg_prediction_confidence > 0.8
ORDER BY g.game_id;

WITH HighTurnoverTeams AS (
    SELECT tm.team_id, t.team_name
    FROM team_metrics tm
    JOIN teams t ON tm.team_id = t.team_id
    WHERE tm.turnover_rate < 0.15 AND tm.season = 2019
),
PredictedGames AS (
    SELECT gp.game_id, gp.confidence_level
    FROM game_predictions gp
    WHERE gp.confidence_level > 0.8
)
SELECT h.team_name
FROM HighTurnoverTeams h
JOIN games g ON (g.home_team_id = h.team_id OR g.away_team_id = h.team_id)
JOIN PredictedGames pg ON g.game_id = pg.game_id
WHERE g.location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "AT&T Stadium, Arlington, TX 76011")
AND g.k = 5;

WITH SimilarHorses AS (
    SELECT hip_no, horse_name, distance
    FROM horses
    WHERE horse_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Champion Stallion")
    AND k = 5
),
RelevantAuctions AS (
    SELECT auction_id
    FROM auctions
    WHERE organizer = 'Top Equine Events'
)
SELECT sh.horse_name
FROM SimilarHorses sh
JOIN horses h ON sh.hip_no = h.hip_no
JOIN RelevantAuctions ra ON h.auction_id = ra.auction_id
ORDER BY sh.distance
LIMIT 1;

WITH HighScoringMarginGames AS (
    SELECT game_id, scoring_margin
    FROM games
    WHERE scoring_margin > 20
),
SimilarWeatherGames AS (
    SELECT game_id, distance
    FROM games
    WHERE weather_conditions_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Clear sky, mild temperature, no wind")
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT p.game_id, AVG(p.confidence_level) AS average_confidence
FROM game_predictions p
JOIN HighScoringMarginGames h ON p.game_id = h.game_id
JOIN SimilarWeatherGames s ON p.game_id = s.game_id
GROUP BY p.game_id
HAVING average_confidence > 0.5;

SELECT h.hip_no
FROM horses h
JOIN breeding b ON h.hip_no = b.hip_no
WHERE h.horse_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Thoroughbred horse known for racing in auctions") AND h.k = 3
AND h.birth_year > 2015
AND h.color = 'Bay'
AND b.generation = 1;

SELECT game_id
FROM games
WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots")
LIMIT 1;

WITH AuctionAnalysis AS (
  SELECT 
    a.auction_id,
    COUNT(h.hip_no) AS total_horses,
    AVG(CAST(h.birth_year AS FLOAT)) AS avg_birth_year
  FROM auctions a
  JOIN horses h ON a.auction_id = h.auction_id
  WHERE a.date > '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY a.auction_id
),
HorsePerformance AS (
  SELECT 
    h.hip_no,
    h.performance_score,
    b.generation
  FROM horses h
  JOIN breeding b ON h.hip_no = b.hip_no
  WHERE h.performance_score IS NOT NULL
),
BreedingSimilarity AS (
  SELECT 
    b.breeding_id,
    b.sire,
    b.dam,
    vec.distance AS similarity_distance
  FROM breeding b
  JOIN (
    SELECT rowid, distance 
    FROM breeding 
    WHERE breeding_notes_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Notable lineage with strong pedigree history")
    ORDER BY distance 
    LIMIT 5
  ) AS vec ON b.rowid = vec.rowid
)
SELECT 
  a.auction_id,
  aa.total_horses,
  aa.avg_birth_year,
  hp.performance_score,
  bs.similarity_distance
FROM auctions a
JOIN AuctionAnalysis aa ON a.auction_id = aa.auction_id
JOIN HorsePerformance hp ON hp.hip_no = a.auction_id
JOIN BreedingSimilarity bs ON bs.breeding_id = hp.hip_no
WHERE hp.generation = 3
ORDER BY aa.total_horses DESC;

WITH SimilarHorses AS (
    SELECT hip_no, horse_name, distance
    FROM horses
    WHERE horse_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Thoroughbred horse with excellent racing pedigree")
    AND k = 5
),
SimilarAuctions AS (
    SELECT auction_id, auction_name, distance
    FROM auctions
    WHERE auction_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Annual horse auction event in Kentucky")
    AND k = 3
)
SELECT h.horse_name
FROM SimilarHorses h
JOIN SimilarAuctions a ON h.hip_no = a.auction_id
WHERE ABS(h.distance - a.distance) < 0.5
ORDER BY h.distance
LIMIT 1;

SELECT game_id, season, week, location_embedding 
FROM games 
WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots") 
ORDER BY distance 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM publishers p
JOIN publishers_metadatachunks01 pm ON p.publisher_id = pm.rowid
WHERE p.publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Leading publisher in the technology sector")
AND pm.data LIKE '%Germany%'
AND k = 3
ORDER BY p.distance;

SELECT hip_no 
FROM horses 
WHERE horse_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Champion Thoroughbred Racehorse') 
ORDER BY distance 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.game_id, t.team_name
FROM games g
JOIN teams t ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
WHERE g.location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots") AND g.k = 5
AND g.season = 2023
AND g.week = 5
ORDER BY g.distance;

WITH SimilarPublishers AS (
  SELECT publisher_id, publisher_name, distance
  FROM publishers
  WHERE publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Penguin Random House")
  ORDER BY distance
  LIMIT 5
),
BooksByPublishers AS (
  SELECT bp.book_id, sp.publisher_id
  FROM book_publisher bp
  JOIN SimilarPublishers sp ON bp.publisher_id = sp.publisher_id
),
InstitutionsFundingBooks AS (
  SELECT bi.book_id, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
  FROM book_institution bi
  JOIN institutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
  WHERE bi.book_id IN (SELECT book_id FROM BooksByPublishers)
)
SELECT i.institution_name
FROM InstitutionsFundingBooks i
JOIN SimilarPublishers sp ON i.institution_id = sp.publisher_id
WHERE sp.distance < 0.5
ORDER BY i.institution_name
LIMIT 1;

WITH HorseColorAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        h.hip_no,
        h.horse_name,
        h.color,
        vec.distance AS color_similarity
    FROM horses h
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM horses 
        WHERE color_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Dark Bay or Brown") 
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON h.rowid = vec.rowid
),
AuctionStatusAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        a.auction_id,
        a.status,
        COUNT(h.hip_no) AS total_horses
    FROM auctions a
    JOIN horses h ON a.auction_id = h.auction_id
    GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.status
),
HorsePerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        h.hip_no,
        h.performance_score,
        LENGTH(h.performance_score) AS score_length
    FROM horses h
),
BestAuctionLocation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.auction_id,
        a.location,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM auctions a
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM auctions 
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Keeneland, Lexington, KY, USA") 
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON a.rowid = vec.rowid
)
SELECT 
    hc.horse_name
FROM HorseColorAnalysis hc
JOIN AuctionStatusAnalysis asa ON hc.hip_no = asa.auction_id
JOIN HorsePerformance hp ON hc.hip_no = hp.hip_no
JOIN BestAuctionLocation bal ON asa.auction_id = bal.auction_id
WHERE asa.total_horses > 10
AND hp.score_length > 5
ORDER BY hc.color_similarity;

SELECT p.publisher_name, a.views
FROM publishers p
JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
JOIN analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
WHERE p.publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Penguin Books, a renowned publisher known for literature.")
AND a.region_with_highest_views = 'Europe'
AND k = 3
ORDER BY a.views DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT game_id, season, week, distance 
FROM games
WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots')
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

SELECT game_id, location, distance 
FROM games 
WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Home team: Patriots") 
ORDER BY distance 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT publisher_name
FROM publishers
WHERE publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Penguin Books, 80 Strand, London, WC2R 0RL, UK")
LIMIT 1;

WITH HorseSearch AS (
    SELECT hip_no, horse_name, auction_id, distance
    FROM horses
    WHERE horse_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Thoroughbred racehorse") 
    AND k = 5
    ORDER BY distance
),
AuctionDetails AS (
    SELECT auction_id, auction_name
    FROM auctions
    WHERE date > '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT a.auction_name
FROM HorseSearch h
JOIN AuctionDetails a ON h.auction_id = a.auction_id;

WITH SectorAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        s.stock_id,
        s.symbol,
        vec.distance AS sector_similarity
    FROM stocks s
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM stocks 
        WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2',"Information Technology sector focusing on cloud services") 
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON s.rowid = vec.rowid
),
ActiveAlerts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        a.stock_id,
        COUNT(*) AS active_alerts_count
    FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY a.user_id, a.stock_id
),
TechnicalIndicatorAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        ti.indicator_id,
        ti.name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ti.category = 'momentum' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS momentum_indicators_count
    FROM technical_indicators ti
    GROUP BY ti.indicator_id, ti.name
)
SELECT 
    md.stock_id,
    sa.symbol,
    ai.active_alerts_count
FROM market_data md
JOIN SectorAnalysis sa ON md.stock_id = sa.stock_id
JOIN ActiveAlerts ai ON ai.stock_id = md.stock_id
JOIN alerts a ON a.user_id = ai.user_id AND a.stock_id = ai.stock_id
JOIN TechnicalIndicatorAnalysis tia ON a.indicator_id = tia.indicator_id
WHERE md.currency = 'USD' AND md.volume > 1000000
ORDER BY md.stock_id;

WITH SimilarInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, institution_name, country, funding_period, distance
    FROM institutions
    WHERE institution_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Institute of Advanced Studies in Science and Technology")
    AND k = 5  -- Limit to top 5 similar institutions
),
PublisherInstitutionLinks AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name, p.country AS publisher_country, i.institution_id, i.distance
    FROM publishers p
    JOIN book_publisher bp ON p.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    JOIN book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
    JOIN SimilarInstitutions i ON bi.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE p.country = 'USA'  -- Additional filtering for publishers in the USA
)
SELECT pil.publisher_name
FROM PublisherInstitutionLinks pil
WHERE pil.distance < 0.3  -- Filter by a distance threshold for similar names
ORDER BY pil.distance
LIMIT 1;  -- Select only the top result based on distance

SELECT stock_id, symbol, distance
FROM stocks
WHERE name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Apple Inc.")
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 3;

WITH BettingDataCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        bd.game_id,
        AVG(bd.betting_spread) AS avg_betting_spread
    FROM betting_data bd
    GROUP BY bd.game_id
),
PredictionDataCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        AVG(gp.confidence_level) AS avg_confidence,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gp.make_pick = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_picks
    FROM game_predictions gp
    GROUP BY gp.game_id
),
TeamMetricsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa
    FROM team_metrics tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_id
),
LocationSimilarityCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM games 
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots")
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
)
SELECT 
    g.game_id
FROM games g
JOIN BettingDataCTE bdc ON g.game_id = bdc.game_id
JOIN PredictionDataCTE pdc ON g.game_id = pdc.game_id
JOIN LocationSimilarityCTE lsc ON g.game_id = lsc.game_id
WHERE pdc.total_picks > 2
ORDER BY g.game_id;

SELECT s.symbol
FROM stocks s
JOIN exchanges e ON s.exchange_id = e.exchange_id
WHERE s.sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector focusing on innovative solutions")
AND e.country = 'USA'
AND s.k = 5
ORDER BY s.distance;

WITH SimilarPublishers AS (
    SELECT publisher_id, distance
    FROM publishers
    WHERE publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Global publishing house known for science journals") 
    AND k = 5
), 
SimilarInstitutions AS (
    SELECT institution_id, distance
    FROM institutions
    WHERE institution_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Leading research university in Europe") 
    AND k = 5
), 
PublisherBooks AS (
    SELECT bp.book_id, sp.publisher_id 
    FROM book_publisher bp
    JOIN SimilarPublishers sp ON bp.publisher_id = sp.publisher_id
), 
InstitutionBooks AS (
    SELECT bi.book_id, si.institution_id 
    FROM book_institution bi
    JOIN SimilarInstitutions si ON bi.institution_id = si.institution_id
)
SELECT a.book_id
FROM analytics a
JOIN PublisherBooks pb ON a.book_id = pb.book_id
JOIN InstitutionBooks ib ON a.book_id = ib.book_id
WHERE a.views > 100
ORDER BY a.book_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT stock_id, symbol
FROM stocks
WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector in Silicon Valley")
AND k = 5
ORDER BY distance;

WITH PublisherInstitutionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.publisher_id,
        bi.institution_id,
        SUM(a.citations) AS total_citations
    FROM 
        book_publisher bp
    JOIN 
        book_institution bi ON bp.book_id = bi.book_id
    JOIN 
        analytics a ON bp.book_id = a.book_id
    GROUP BY 
        bp.publisher_id, bi.institution_id
    HAVING 
        SUM(a.citations) > 100
),
SimilarLicenses AS (
    SELECT 
        l.license_id,
        l.license_name,
        distance
    FROM 
        licenses l
    WHERE 
        l.description_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Open access with minimal restrictions") 
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    p.publisher_name
FROM 
    publishers p
JOIN 
    PublisherInstitutionAnalysis pia ON p.publisher_id = pia.publisher_id
JOIN 
    SimilarLicenses sl ON sl.license_id = (SELECT license_id
                                           FROM licenses
                                           WHERE licenses.license_id = sl.license_id
                                           LIMIT 1)
WHERE 
    p.country = 'USA'
ORDER BY 
    pia.total_citations DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT stock_id, distance
FROM stocks
WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector in Silicon Valley")
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1;

WITH SimilarPublishers AS (
    SELECT 
        publisher_id, 
        publisher_name,
        distance
    FROM 
        publishers
    WHERE 
        publisher_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Penguin Random House") 
    AND k = 5
),
SimilarInstitutions AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id, 
        institution_name,
        distance
    FROM 
        institutions
    WHERE 
        institution_name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Oxford University") 
    AND k = 5
),
CombinedResults AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.publisher_id, 
        sp.publisher_name, 
        si.institution_id,
        si.institution_name,
        (sp.distance + si.distance) / 2 AS avg_distance
    FROM 
        SimilarPublishers sp
    JOIN 
        SimilarInstitutions si 
    ON 
        sp.publisher_id = si.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    publisher_name
FROM 
    CombinedResults
ORDER BY 
    avg_distance
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.data_id, s.symbol, m.close
FROM market_data m
JOIN stocks s ON m.stock_id = s.stock_id
WHERE s.sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector stocks listed in the USA")
AND m.currency = 'USD'
AND m.date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
AND s.k = 5
ORDER BY m.close DESC;

WITH LocationAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        g.location,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM games 
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots") 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
),
WeatherAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        vec.distance AS weather_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM games 
        WHERE weather_conditions_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Sunny and clear sky") 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        tm.season,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa
    FROM team_metrics tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_id, tm.season
),
GameAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        (la.location_similarity + wa.weather_similarity) AS combined_similarity,
        COUNT(*) AS total_teams,
        tp.avg_wdvoa
    FROM games g
    JOIN LocationAnalysis la ON g.game_id = la.game_id
    JOIN WeatherAnalysis wa ON g.game_id = wa.game_id
    JOIN TeamPerformance tp ON g.home_team_id = tp.team_id
    GROUP BY g.game_id
)
SELECT 
    ga.combined_similarity
FROM GameAnalysis ga
ORDER BY ga.combined_similarity DESC;

SELECT stock_id, distance
FROM stocks
WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector")
AND stocks.k = 5;

SELECT stock_id, distance
FROM stocks
WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector in Silicon Valley")
LIMIT 1;
